sam-support: FYI escalated ticket from AcmeCorp — AP says the invoice PDF we generated via the invoices API is missing the registered legal entity line and their PO# isn't in the header. They also reported a card decline on the retry. Opening thread to sync on formatting + payment repro. attached: acme-invoice-sample.pdf
miro-finance: Ack. Can you paste a minimal payload that produced the PDF? need to repro quickly for legal entity field + PO placement.
jin-payments: Card decline noted — we have the decline code in payments logs (card_network_decline). I'll pull the charge attempt timestamps once we have the invoice id. For the PDF: are we using the legacy template or the new multi-entity template?
sam-support: Payload below (from customer):
```json
{
  "customer_id": "acct_ACME123",
  "currency": "EUR",
  "items": [
    {"description":"Platform usage - Mar 2026","quantity":1,"unit_amount":12500},
    {"description":"Support - incident hours","quantity":2,"unit_amount":2500}
  ],
  "billing_address": {
    "line1":"1 Market St",
    "city":"Dublin",
    "postal_code":"D02",
    "country":"IE"
  },
  "metadata": {"po_number":"98765"}
}
```
miro-finance: Thanks. Two quick notes: (1) For EU customers we expect a VAT/tax_id field under legal_entity (tax_id and vat_number). (2) PO numbers should be rendered both in the PDF header and as a separate line item / metadata block for AP. Looks like the payload only has metadata.po_number and no legal_entity object.
alice-billing: We also need a clear "sold_to" vs "bill_to" section for companies that have different remit addresses. Acme wants the seller legal entity in header: "Redwood Inference, Inc. (EU branch) - VAT: IE1234567F". If the template skips this, AP will reject it.
pdfbot: Template engine warning: template "classic_single_entity_v1" will omit tax fields if legal_entity object is absent. Consider switching to "multi_entity_v2" which supports sold_to/bill_to and per-line tax rates.
sam-support: Customer claims they used the invoices.generate endpoint + attach_pdf=true. They say the pdf has customer name and address but not the registered company/legal name or tax id. Example of what we want in header: "Redwood Inference Ltd. | Reg. No. 98765 | VAT: GB999999999". Is that a field we can auto-populate?
milo-finance: (typo fix) miro-finance: We can't auto-populate customer-side legal names; the service must accept a legal_entity input. For our outgoing invoices we should always include our own seller legal entity block — ensure seller_legal_entity config is present in the tenant settings.
jin-payments: For the card failure: logged attempt at 2026-05-02T14:12:07Z for invoice_id inv_1791. Decline matched issuer response: "do_not_honor". That's independent but AP won't pay until invoice is corrected. We should surface the invoice PDF version id in the payment retry flow so customers can confirm the corrected PDF before retry.
alice-billing: Suggested formatting checklist for the PDF template (short):
- Header: seller_legal_entity_name, registration_number, seller_tax_id/VAT
- Header: invoice_number, invoice_date, PO number (prominent)
- Bill To / Sold To blocks (full addresses, contact email)
- Line items: description (one-line), sku or internal code, quantity, unit price, tax_rate, tax_amount, line_total
- Subtotals: subtotal, tax subtotal(s) by rate, discounts, total due (currency & minor units)
- Footer: payment instructions, bank details (IBAN/BIC) or payment link, legal notes, seller address and registered office
sam-support: Nice. Any opinion on whether to require PO present in header for all EU invoices? Some customers use PO only in metadata.
miro-finance: For AP workflows, PO in header is standard. Accept metadata.po_number but also copy it into header during PDF generation. Add a QA check: if metadata.po_number exists, render header PO field; if not present and customer.account_settings.enforce_po == true, mark invoice as "requires PO" and reject PDF generation until provided.
pdfbot: Implementation hint: add template variable {{metadata.po_number}} with fallback to {{billing.invoice_reference}} and ensure it's escaped. Also include optional block: {% if legal_entity.vat_number %} display VAT line {% endif %}.
sam-support: Repro steps for devs assigned to this thread:
1) Use the payload above and call POST /v1/invoices.generate?attach_pdf=true with customer_id acct_ACME123
2) Check generated PDF at invoices.get_pdf(inv_1791) — look for header fields.
3) If missing, switch template to multi_entity_v2 via tenant settings and regenerate.
4) For payment retry: call POST /v1/payments/retry with invoice_id and check payments.log for decline code.
jin-payments: I'll follow step 4 after you confirm the invoice id we used in their failing retry. Also adding a note: when PO is present only in metadata we still sign the PDF hash using the same digest; ensure the metadata copy doesn't change PDF signature behavior.
miro-finance: After patching templates, we should add an automated visual regression test: render sample invoices for - EU corporate with VAT, - US corporation with EIN, - multi-entity reseller — and diff PDFs to ensure header includes legal entity fields.
alice-billing: For documentation: update invoices API reference to list required fields for AP-ready PDFs and show example payloads for PO placement and line item tax breakdowns.
sam-support: OK assigning owner @miro-finance to coordinate template and @jin-payments to follow up on the decline and retry UX. I'll reply to the ticket with these repro steps and request the original invoice_id and sample PDF from customer. :thumbsup:
